content: Farisifɔ Bodunká Ofúla
Ɛkɛ ɔkʋ Farisifɔ pʋ́ Sadukifɔ akʋ bɛba Yesu ɔsɔ́kɩkpa. Mʋ́ sʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, ɔbwɛ́ɛ osúna pʋsuna amʋ́ ánɩ́ lɛ́lɛ́ otsú Bulu wá.
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ owí ɩpɔn, nsaɩntɔ ɩpɛ́ á, mlɩtɛblɩ́ mlɩaa, ‘Ɔkɛ nsaɩntɔ bɛ́dɩ.’
Nɩ́ nyankpʋ obílá tuun nyankɩ a, mlɩtɛblɩ́ mlɩaa, ‘Ndɛ nyankpʋ obótswie tsʋn afú.’ Mlɩtɛtálɩ́ kɩ nsaɩntɔ, bɩ́ tɔ́á ɩbɛ́ba. Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩmɛ́tálɩ́ nú tɔ́á mlɩdéwúun séi ánfɩ mʋ́ asɩ.
Mlɩ ndɛmba-abí laláhɛ ánɩ́ mlɩladálɩ Bulu ɔma, mlɩdɛ́ osúna dunká amlɩwun, támɛ mlɩmóowun kʋkʋʋkʋ dʋn Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yona osúna amʋ odu.” Ɩ́nɩ sʋ ɔlɛnatɩ́ sí amʋ́.
Farisifɔ Pʋ́ Sadukifɔ Bodobodotu-afá
Yesu akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bʋmɛkaɩ́n tsú bodobodo kɩ́tá asa bɛfa ɔpʋ amʋ yɔ́ ɔbɩn.
Yesu lɛ́da amʋ́ ɔlá ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkɩ wankláán Farisifɔ pʋ́ Sadukifɔ Bodobodotu-afásʋ́.”
Akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛfɩtɛ́ aba bɛɛ, “Bodobodo amʋ́ʋ́ anɩmɛ́dɛ́ ámʋ sʋ́ ɔdɛ asʋ́n ánfɩ blɩ́ lóó?”
Yesu lónu asʋ́n ánɩ́ bʋdɛblɩ́. Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Óo, mlɩ hógyi mɔ́tsɔ́. Ntogyi sʋ́ mlɩdɛ́blɩ́ mlɩaa bodobodo ámʋ́ʋ́ mlɩmɛ́dɛ́ ámʋ sʋ?
Ɩmɔkʋ́wánkɩ́ mlɩ kɩ? Mlɩlatan bodobodo apin anu ámʋ́ʋ́ nɛha ahá mpɩ́m-nu (5,000) begyi amʋsʋ? Alakpá afɩnɩ lésían mlɩlɔ́tɔsɩ́?
Ntɛ́ɛ mlɩlatan bodobodo apin asienɔ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ nɛha ahá mpɩ́m-na (4,000) begyi amʋsʋ? Alakpá afɩnɩ lésián mlɩlɔ́tɔsɩ́?”
Ntogyi sʋ́ ɩmɔkʋ́wánkɩ́ mlɩ ánɩ́ megyí bodobodo ɩwɩ asʋ́n ndɛblɩ́? Bláa ndɛ mlɩ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩkɩ wankláán Farisifɔ pʋ́ Sadukifɔ Bodobodotu-afásʋ́.”
Ɩnʋ asa ɩlɔwankɩ́ amʋ́ ánɩ́ megyí Bodobodotu-afásʋ́ ɔdɛ, mboún amʋ́ atosunáhɛ́.
Ɔhá Ánɩ́ Yesu Gyí
Brɛ́á Yesu lówie Kaesarea Filipi nsáɩntɔ á, ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ma ahá bɛɛ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ ngyi?”
Bɛlɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ bɛɛ, “Akʋ bɛɛ, fʋ́gyí Asú Ɔbɔpʋ́ Yohane. Akʋ bɛɛ, Bulu Ɔnɔ́sʋ́ Ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Elia. Akʋ ɛ́ bɛɛ, Yeremia ntɛ́ɛ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ bambá ɔkʋ.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛfɩtɛ́ amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩ ɛ́ mɛ́? Mlɩa mɩ́gyí ma?”
Simon Petro lɛ́lɛ mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Fʋ́gyí Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ) nɩ. Bulu Ɔkɩankpapʋ amʋ mʋ Bi.”
Ɩnʋ Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bulu layúlá fʋ́ Simon, Yona mʋ bi, tsúfɛ́ megyí nyankpʋsa ɔkʋkʋ lɛ́lɛ ɔnɔkwalɩ anfɩ ɔwan súná fʋ́. Mɩ́ Sɩ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔbʋ ɔsʋ́sʋ́ ámʋ nɩ.
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ mɩ́ ɛ́ ndɛ fʋ́ bláa mbɛ́ɛ, fʋ́ dá gyí Petro. Mʋ́ asɩ gyí, ‘Bʋtá.’ Bʋtá ánfɩsʋ néyi mɩ́ ɔpasua dɩ́nká nɩ́. Lowu túmi mɛ́ɛtalɩ́ gyí mʋ́sʋ́ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.
Nɔ́pʋ Bulu iwíegyí ámʋ asáafɩ wá fʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ. Asʋ́ngyíasʋ́n ánɩ́ fékiná ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ anfɩsʋ á, Bulu ɛ́ obékiná mʋ́ ɔsʋ́sʋ́. Mʋ́á fótsulá á, Bulu ɛ́ obótsulá mʋ́sʋ́ ɔsʋ́sʋ́.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛda amʋ́ ɔlá kpákpáákpá ɔbɛ́ɛ, bʋmábláa ɔhaa ánɩ́ mʋgyí Kristo amʋ.
Yesu Ɩwɩɔsɩn Pʋ́ Mʋ Lowu Ɩwɩ Asʋ́n Blɩ́

Tsú brɛ́ ámʋsʋ á, Yesu léfi asɩ ɔdɛ asʋ́ntɔ́ lɛ súná amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ilehián ánɩ́ mɔ́yɔ Yerusalem yówun ɩwɩɔsɩn tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ Yudafɔ ahandɛ, Bulu igyí ahapʋ́ dɛhɛn pʋ́ Mose mbla asunápʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ. Bɔ́mɔ mʋ, támɛ Bulu ɔbɛ́lakʋ́sʋ́a mʋ ɛkɛ sáásɩ́ tsú afúlitɔ.”
Mʋ́ sʋ Petro lɛ́tɩ mʋ ya ɩtsɛ́tɔ́, yɛ́ka mʋ itin ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mɩ́ Wíé, Bulu ogyáa mʋ́ tɛ́ɩ́ ya fʋ́ ɩwɩ. Ɩ́nɩ mába fʋsʋ ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ.”
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛdamlí bláa Petro ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Satan, natɩ tɛɩ mɩ́sʋ́! Fʋdɛ mɩ́ ɔkpa tíin. Megyí tɔ́á Bulu dɛ́gywɩɩ́n fʋdɛgywɩɩ́n, anyánkpʋ́sa klɛ́ fʋdɛgywɩɩ́n.”
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ ɔkʋ dékléá obóbuo mɩ á, osíi tɔ́á otekle bwɛ, otsu mʋ oyikpalíhɛ bobuo mɩ.
Tsúfɛ́ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lɛ́prɩ mʋ nkpa á, ɩbɔ́hʋlɩ́ɩ mʋ. Támɛ nɩ́ ɔkʋ lési mʋ nkpa há mɩ́ sʋ á, ɔbɛ́lanyá nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá.
Nɩ́ ɔkʋ onyá ɔyɩ́tɔ́ atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́, támɛ ɔhʋ́lɩ mʋ ɔkláa a, labi mɔmʋ ɩlɔwa há mʋ? Ntɛ́ɛ ntɔ ɔha ɔbɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́tsɛ mʋ nkpa?
Tsúfɛ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nɛ́ba mɩ́ Sɩ́ numnyamtɔ, mɩ́a mʋ abɔpʋ. Ɩnʋ́ nɛ́ka ɔhagyíɔha ɩkɔ alɩá mʋ tsiátɔ́ gyi nɩ́.
Ɔnɔkwalɩ ndɛ mlɩ bláa. Akʋ bʋbʋ mlɩtɔ nfɩ ánɩ́ bʋmóowu, yɔ́fʋn brɛ́á bawun ánɩ́ mɩ́, Nyankpʋsa-Mʋ-Bi ánfɩ nɛbá mɩ́ iwíe ogyíkpá.”
